purpose: Assess family-resampling uncertainty in the two recently admitted OrthoBench declines without changing inference or selecting new parameters.
timing: Declared after examining candidate point estimates, before generating this readout's bootstrap draws. Post hoc development diagnostic, not prospective registration or independent confirmation.
input: Independently admitted OrthoBench family sufficient statistics in hillclimb_comparison_readback_v22_20261014/summary.json, bound to its native/scorer records.
control: Use their matched min4/first_hit canonical control only after all 70 RefOG records, including family names and sizes, are proven identical between the two retained controls. Equal aggregate F1 alone is insufficient.
algorithm: Reuse benchmark_tools.bootstrap_orthobench.paired_bootstrap. Draw 70 RefOGs with replacement, sharing family multiplicities across all methods. Recompute weighted TP/FP/FN totals and F1/precision/recall in every draw; do not average family F1 or assume independent gene pairs.
outputs: JSON with point estimates, nominal paired percentile intervals and six-endpoint Bonferroni-tail intervals; TSV with signed candidate-minus-control changes in percentage points; native/scorer/source/runtime provenance.
verification: Require one verified OrthoBench cell per candidate, unchanged table F1 and full gene universe, identical matched-control family records, reproduction of all retained point estimates from sufficient statistics, input hashes before/after, and deterministic replay of the same seed.
limits: Intervals assume exchangeable reference families and do not correct for shared evolutionary histories, fused predictions, prior method selection, run-to-run variation, species sampling, or dataset shift. Adjustment covers only these six readout endpoints, not all historical searches. An interval containing zero does not establish equivalence; the 0.005 decline heuristic remains a development screen.
